purpose: A real Batman/SpongeBob episode demonstrates the supplied-media workflow. Diagnostic proofs separately test two different inputs through the same runtime.

examples.title: Gotham Meets Optimism
whyItWorks: A fresh agent rendered a 16.76-second Batman/SpongeBob exchange on its first attempt with no runtime changes or coaching.
11 tests, both smoke proofs, full decoding and 18 sampled caption frames passed.
knownWeaknesses: Gameplay and six voice clips were prepared before handoff; acquisition and voice generation are not in this release.
Detailed voice-performance, pacing and caption/speech review remains unrecorded.

examples.title: Same universe + crossover
whyItWorks: Two different scripts, casts, video sources and audio sequences use the same official renderer.
All assets for these free local checks ship in the ZIP.
knownWeaknesses: Diagnostic tones are not character speech; these checks do not establish creative fidelity.
